name: Emergency Extraction
flavor_text: "I’m... I’m here. Just hold on a little longer. I've got you."

name: Cockpit Sanctuary
flavor_text: "It’s... quieter in here. I can actually think when the hatch is closed."

name: Unspoken Trust
flavor_text: "If the boss says it’s the right way... then I’ll follow him. I trust his judgment."

name: Zephyr's Gale
flavor_text: "Don’t blink. You might miss me."

name: Silent Duty
flavor_text: "I don’t need a thank you. Just... please stay safe out there."

name: Precision Calibration
flavor_text: "Just... one more adjustment. If the timing is off by a millisecond, the shield won't hold."

name: Against the Odds
flavor_text: "I... I can't let them die. Not while I'm still in the air."

name: Shadow Support
flavor_text: "I'll stay in the blind spot. You just focus on the target... I've got the rest."

name: Void Reflection
flavor_text: "The stars are so quiet. I wish... I wish the rest of the galaxy felt like this."

name: The Zephyr
flavor_text: "You're the only one who doesn't ask me to talk... just keep me flying, okay?"

name: Shedding the Armor
flavor_text: "I... I've never let anyone see me like this. Please... don't look at me too hard."

name: Secret Solitude
flavor_text: "Mnh... ah... I can't stop thinking about him... the way he looks at me... hngh..."

name: Silent Devotion
flavor_text: "Hngh... gluck... mmph... I just want to... make you feel good... slurp..."

name: Systems Overload
flavor_text: "Ah! Haa... gasp... it's too much... I can't... I can't think straight! Please... more! Ahhh!"

name: Safe Harbor
flavor_text: "I feel... so quiet now. Not the lonely kind of quiet... but... the kind where I finally feel like I belong."

name: Social Butterfly
flavor_text: "Hiya! I'm Farlin! Who wants to be my new best friend? Please say me! I brought snacks!"

name: Pastel Valkyrie
flavor_text: Do you think these glittery decals make the Frame look too flashy? Personally, I think they're just right! ✨"

name: Commander's Headache
flavor_text: "Aww, look at Commander Kaiser making his 'serious face' again! You're so cute when you're stressed, Boss!"

name: Sparkle Shield
flavor_text: "Don't worry, I've got you covered! Just stay behind me and try not to get any scratches on your armor, okay?"

name: Midnight Snack Raid
flavor_text: "Oops! Did I steal your dessert? My bad! But it looked so yummy, I just couldn't help myself! Teehee!"

name: Pink Blitz
flavor_text: "Okay, okay! I'll stop talking and start blasting! Everyone, get behind me! This is gonna be LOUD! ✨💥"

name: Victory Afterparty
flavor_text: "Mission accomplished! Now, who's in charge of the music? I've got a playlist that'll wake up the whole sector! Let's get this party started!"

name: Galactic Glow-Up
flavor_text: "I don't care if we're in a war zone, a girl's gotta keep her skin hydrated! You want some moisturizer, Commander? You look a little... stressed!"

name: Sweet Destruction
flavor_text: "Oops! Did I accidentally blow up their entire front line? Teehee! I guess I just got a little too excited! My bad!"

name: Valkyrie: Steel Angel
flavor_text: "Isn't she just the most gorgeous thing you've ever seen? I spent three hours polishing the cockpit glass today! We're gonna look fabulous while we're saving everyone!"

name: Private Preview
flavor_text: "Hehe, you’ve been staring at my pilot suit all day, Boss! I figured I’d save you the trouble... want to see what’s underneath? ✨"

name: Solo Mission
flavor_text: "Mmm... hnnngh... I can't stop thinking about the way the Commander looks at me... slurp... Ah, I wish he was here to help me finish this..."

name: Specialized Support
flavor_text: "I'm the best support pilot in the fleet, remember? That means I know exactly how to take care of my Commander... gluck, slurp... Teehee, you like that, right?"

name: Core Overload
flavor_text: "Ah! Yes! Right there! Haa... ahhh! Give me everything, Boss! I'm gonna... I'm gonna blow a fuse! Screams softly AAAHHH!"

name: Cool Down Cycle
flavor_text: "Mmm... best... mission... ever... Yawns and cuddles closer... Let's just stay like this for a while, okay? No more orders, no more mechs... just us."

name: Iron bastion
flavor_text: "You may attempt to breach this line, but I assure you, you will find it an exercise in futility."

name: Tactical Synchronization
flavor_text: "Your orders are clear, Commander. I shall be the anvil upon which our enemies are broken."

name: Steady  Pulse
flavor_text: "Panic is a luxury we cannot afford. Focus on the objective; I will handle the pressure."

name: Unyielding Pillar
flavor_text: "Stand behind me. As long as I am operational, none of you shall fall."

name: Calculated Outcome
flavor_text: "The results were predictable, provided one followed the tactical parameters to the letter. It was... satisfactory."

name: Fragile Peace
flavor_text: "Peace is a beautiful concept, but in this galaxy, the only true stability is found in a well-maintained shield."

name: Silent Vigil
flavor_text: "If I waver, the line collapses. I do not have the luxury of doubt, nor the time for hesitation."

name: Operational Readiness
flavor_text: "The reports are filed and the tea has gone cold. It is time to return to the cockpit."

name: Absolute Denial
flavor_text: "Your aggression is impressive, but it is ultimately irrelevant. You shall not move me a single centimeter."

name: The Bulwark's Resolve
flavor_text: "The Bulwark does not retreat. It simply waits for the enemy to exhaust themselves against its hull."

name: Unarmored
flavor_text: "I have spent all day encased in steel, Commander. I find I am quite eager to feel your skin against mine instead."

name: Hidden Heat
flavor_text: "I can maintain my composure in the heat of battle... but in the silence of my quarters... hnh... I cannot stop thinking about you."

name: Devoted Service
flavor_text: "Allow me to handle this, Commander. I shall ensure you are fully... satisfied. Mmmph... ah..."

name: Absolute Union
flavor_text: "Commander... ah! I... I cannot... nnngh! Please, do not stop... just... more! Give me everything!"

name: Shared Silence
flavor_text: "I believe this is the only time I truly feel at peace. I am... content, Commander."

name: Mantis Strike
flavor_text: "Target neutralized. I am moving to the next coordinate. Do not deviate from the formation."

name: Iron Discipline
flavor_text: "Emotion is a variable that interferes with precision. In the cockpit, there is only the objective."

name: The Commander's Shadow
flavor_text: "Your orders are absolute, Commander. I will ensure you return from this operation. Regardless of the cost."

name: Silent Guardian
flavor_text: "Apex is overextending. I will bridge the gap. Maintain your position and do not look back."

name: Neural Sync
flavor_text: "The machine does not hesitate. Neither do I. We are one single, precise instrument of intent."

name: Eternal Vigil
flavor_text: "Victory is a temporary state. We do not celebrate; we simply prepare for the next deployment."

name: The Cracked Mask
flavor_text: "I... I cannot report a failure if you are not here to receive it, Commander. Please... do not take unnecessary risks."

name: Zero-Point Execution
flavor_text: "Target locked. Time dilation active. This will be over before you realize you have lost."

name: Soldier's Solitude
flavor_text: "The silence that follows the alarms is the loudest part of the day. It is the only time I can hear myself think."

name: Mantis
flavor_text: High-frequency blades, reinforced agility actuators, and a zero-latency response. Mantis is not a vehicle; it is a surgical instrument. And I am the one who wields the blade."

name: Unveiled Discipline
flavor_text: "The uniform is off, Commander. I am... completely open to your inspection now. Please... don't look away."

name: Silent Desire
flavor_text: (Heavy, shaky breathing) "I cannot... focus on the reports... when my body feels like this. Hnn... Kaiser... I want you here..."

name: Honored Service
flavor_text: "I will ensure every inch is attended to with precision. Mmph... I want to feel you... I want to please you, Commander."

name: Neural Overload
flavor_text: "Commander! Ah! I... I can't hold it back anymore... Nggh... More... please, give me more! Aah!"

name: Shared Silence
flavor_text: (Whispering softly, leaning against him) "For a moment... the noise of the war feels very far away. Just stay like this... just for a little longer."

name: Simulation Stress
flavor_text: "I-I know the manual by heart, but the simulator always feels so much faster than the textbook! Just one more run... I have to get it right."

name: Breathless Salute
flavor_text: "S-Sir! Reporting for duty! I've already completed the perimeter check... wait, was I staring? I wasn't staring! Sorry, Sir!"

name: Rookie's Resolve
flavor_text: "I'm terrified... I'm absolutely terrified! But I can't let the Commander see me shake. I'm a mercenary of Eden now!"

name: Aspiring Ace
flavor_text: "One day, I won't just be the one following orders. I'll be the pilot who saves the day and earns a real smile from the Commander."

name: The Harriet Maneuver
flavor_text: "Focus... breath... now! I—I actually did it! Did you see that, Commander?! I executed the turn perfectly!"

name: Shattered Confidence
flavor_text: "The metal... it just crumpled like paper. I thought I was ready, but the battlefield doesn't care about textbooks. I... I have so much further to go."

name: Under the Wing
flavor_text: "I know I'm just a rookie and I'm probably getting in the way, but please... tell me how you handle the G-force during a dive! I want to be as smooth as you guys."

name: Overclocked Heart
flavor_text: "Everything is slowing down... I can see the trajectory! I don't feel the fear anymore, only the rhythm of the reactor. Just one more hit!"

name: Unspoken Loyalty
flavor_text: "I'll keep the rear guarded. I don't care about the glory or the medals... I just want to make sure the Commander comes back safe. That's all that matters."

name: Pawn's Potential
flavor_text: "It might just be a standard-issue training Frame, but if I push the reactors to the limit, I can keep up with the veterans!"

name: Beyond the Flight Suit
flavor_text: "I-I’ve never... done this for anyone before. Please... shaky breath... don't look at me too hard, Sir. I think I'm turning red just thinking about you seeing me like this..."

name: Solitary Longing
flavor_text: "Soft, shaky moan... if only the Commander was here... I can almost feel his hand on me... huff... mmm... please... just once, I want him to look at me like that..."

name: Ready to Serve
flavor_text: Slurp... gluck... I want to... make you feel good, Sir... muffled moan... am I doing it right? Please... tell me if I'm doing it right..."

name: Devoted Submission
flavor_text: "Aah! Loud, breathless moan... it's too much... I can't... gasp... please, don't stop! I'm yours... everything I am is yours! Shuddering, high-pitched cry!"

name: Afterglow Tranquility
flavor_text: "Soft, content sigh... I can't believe this is real. Just... stay like this for a while, okay? I've never felt so... safe. I love you, Sir."

name: The Reluctant Scout
flavor_text: "I-I'll do my best, Commander... p-please don't be too harsh if I... if I make a mistake."

name: Ghost in the Static
flavor_text: "T-they can't see me... I'm just a glitch in their sensors. I-I've got the target in my sights."

name: Trembling Resolve
flavor_text: "D-did I... did I do it right? I-I spent all night double-checking the intel... I hope it's enough for you, sir."

name: The Unseen Eye
flavor_text: "I-I've mapped the perimeter. The gaps in their security are... u-um, quite wide. They're completely oblivious."

name: Shadow's Vow
flavor_text: "I... I won't let them touch you, Commander. I'll stay in the dark... so you can stay in the light."

name: Sudden Strike
flavor_text: "T-they never even saw the blade... It's much easier to do my job when they aren't... u-um... looking at me."

name: Overwhelmed
flavor_text: "T-too many signals! I can't... I can't find a gap in the radar! Commander, p-please... tell me where to go!"

name: Hangar Solitude
flavor_text: "I-I'm back... I'm safe. P-please... just for a little while... can I just stay here in the dark?"

name: The Weight of the Void
flavor_text: "I-I don't understand why this war never ends... but as long as you're leading us, I-I'll keep hiding in the shadows for you."

name: The Silent Panther
flavor_text: "S-she's the only one who doesn't... judge me. Whisper is the only place where I feel like I actually b-belong."

name: Vulnerable State
flavor_text: "I-I've never... d-done this before. P-please... just tell me if I'm doing it right, Commander... blushes deeply... Is... is it okay that you're looking?"

name: Private Frequency
flavor_text: "H-haah... I can't stop t-thinking about you... nnnh... I just want... I want you to be the one doing this to me... please... soft moan..."

name: Serve the Shadow
flavor_text: "Mmph... n-nn... wet sounds... I-I want to make you feel g-good... I'll do everything you w-want, sir... gluck... I-I'll be a good girl for you..."

name: Absolute Surrender
flavor_text: "A-ah! Haaah... P-please... don't stop... I-I'm yours... nnngh... I'm all yours, Commander! loud, breathless moan... More... please give me m-more!"

name: The Softest Shadow
flavor_text: "I-I... I didn't know it could feel l-like that... soft, sleepy sigh... can we just... stay like this for a little while? I-I feel... so safe with you."

name: The Watchful Eye
flavor_text: "I’ve got your six. Just keep moving forward; I’ll make sure the path is clear for you."

name: A Gentle Word
flavor_text: "It's okay to be scared. We just have to hold onto each other until the fighting stops."

name: The Commander's Confidante
flavor_text: "You don't have to carry the weight of the whole galaxy on your shoulders alone, Kaiser. Let me help you for a while."

name: Light in the Void
flavor_text: "Even in a galaxy of iron and fire, there is still room for a little bit of kindness. That's what keeps us human."

name: Oracle's Guidance
flavor_text: "Scanning... I've found a gap in their line. Now is your chance—please, be careful out there!"

name: Final Sanctuary
flavor_text: "I don't care about the objective! Get the wounded out of here now—I'll hold the line as long as I can!"

name: Echoes of the Fallen
flavor_text: "I still remember the sound of their laughter in the mess hall... it's so quiet now, isn't it?"

name: The Quiet Anchor
flavor_text: "Close your eyes for a second. Just breathe. We've survived worse than this, and we will survive this too."

name: Price of Peace
flavor_text: "They call us mercenaries, but I just hope that by being here, we've prevented a few more hearts from breaking."

name: The Oracle's Sight
flavor_text: "You and I, Oracle... we're the only ones who see the whole picture. Let's make sure everyone comes home today."

name: Beyond the Armor
flavor_text: "Finally... out of this suit. I’ve been waiting all day to feel your skin against mine, Kaiser. Come here... let me help you with yours."

name: Secret Longing
flavor_text: [Soft, shaky breathing] "Nnn... Commander... I can't stop thinking about the way you look at me. I just... I need to feel something other than the war for a little while... ahhh..."

name: Devotion's Depth
flavor_text: [Muffled, wet sounds of sucking and humming] "Mmmph... I want to take all your stress away. Just relax, honey... let me take care of everything for you."

name: Absolute Union
flavor_text: [Gasping, rhythmic breaths] "Oh! Yes... right there! Please, don't stop... I love you, Commander! Ah! Ahhh! Give it all to me!"

name: Safe Harbor
flavor_text: [A soft, contented sigh as she cuddles close] "Stay like this for a little longer. No wars, no mechs, no commands... just us. You're safe here with me, Commander."

name: Breakroom Slump
flavor_text: "I’m not procrastinating, Chief. I’m strategically conserving my energy for the next deployment."

name: Long-Range Rain
flavor_text: "Don't blink. You'll miss the part where everything over there stops existing."

name: Reliable Overwatch
flavor_text: "Just keep moving forward. I've got a clear line of sight, and I'm feeling lucky today."

name: Quake's Footfall
flavor_text: "She’s a bit heavy on the landing, but Quake has a heart of gold... and a cannon the size of a skyscraper."

name: Post-Battle Wind-down
flavor_text: "Mission accomplished! Now, let's talk about that soda machine. I think I deserve a refill."

name: Calm Amidst Chaos
flavor_text: "Chief, you're getting that vein in your forehead again. Just take a breath; I've already got the target locked."

name: Overclocked Barrel
flavor_text: "The techs told me not to push the firing rate this high. But they aren't the ones who have to deal with those pesky drones, are they?"

name: Precision Coordinates
flavor_text: "Just send me the map and a snack, and I'll make sure nothing is left standing in that zip code."

name: Holo-Series Binge
flavor_text: "I can't go on a stealth mission right now, Chief. The season finale is in ten minutes and I've waited three months for this."

name: Quake
flavor_text: "She’s a bit of a space-hog in the hangar, but once she starts singing, everyone else stops talking. Trust me."

name: Shedding the Armor
flavor_text: "Man, this pilot suit is a nightmare to get out of... here, give me a hand, Chief? I can't reach the zipper on the back."

name: Solo Calibration
flavor_text: "Mmm... hnghh... who knew the quiet hours in the barracks could be this... satisfying? Soft, rhythmic moaning..."

name: Specialized Service
flavor_text: "I usually handle the long-range stuff, but I think I'm starting to like the close-up work way more... slurp... like this, right?"

name: Maximum Output
flavor_text: "Oh god... Chief! Ah! Right there... don't stop! Loud, breathless moans and heavy panting... I can't... I can't think straight!"

name: Cool-Down Cycle
flavor_text: "Heh... now that's what I call a successful mission. Yawning... I'm starving. You think the vending machine is still stocked with those chocolate bars?"

name: Redline Sprint
flavor_text: "If you blink, you're dead. And trust me, you're gonna blink."

name: Selective Hearing
flavor_text: "I heard you perfectly fine, Commander. I just decided your plan sucked."

name: The Redline Gamble
flavor_text: "Safety protocols are for people who are afraid to die. Now watch this!"

name: Adrenaline Spike
flavor_text: "God, I can feel my heart hammering against my ribs... Give me more! More!"

name: Victory Lap
flavor_text: "Did you see that shit?! Absolute perfection! Now, who's buying the drinks?"

name: Edge of the Abyss
flavor_text: "Who cares if it's a suicide mission? The view from the edge is the only part worth seeing!"

name: Freelance Chaos
flavor_text: "Strategy is just a fancy word for 'I'm too scared to just charge in.' Get out of my way, Commander!"

name: Blazing Blitz
flavor_text: "I can't hear you over the sound of everything exploding! HAHAHA!"

name: The Showstopper
flavor_text: "I know, I know. I'm a goddamn miracle. Now stop staring and get me a drink!"

name: Firebrand: Full Throttle
flavor_text: "She's the only thing in this damn galaxy that can actually keep up with me. Now let's see how fast this bitch can really go!"

name: Off-Duty Unwinding
flavor_text: "You've been staring at me in that flight suit for three hours, Commander. Why don't you stop pretending to read the reports and help me get this shit off?"

name: Provate Calibration
flavor_text: "Nnn... god... a sharp, shaky intake of breath... I can still feel the way he looked at me... just a little more... soft, desperate moan..."

name: The Deep Dive
flavor_text: "Wet, rhythmic slurping sounds followed by a muffled, humming moan... You like that, don't you? Bet you've never had a pilot handle you with this much precision..."

name: Critical Mass
flavor_text: "Harder! Fuck, just like that! A loud, unrestrained scream of pleasure... Give me everything you've got! Don't you dare hold back!"

name: Post-Flight Cool Down
flavor_text: "Heavy, exhausted breathing and a soft, lazy laugh... Damn. I think that's the first time I've actually been speechless. Not bad, Boss. Not bad at all."

name: Flawless Execution
flavor_text: "Did you see that, Boss? Not a single scratch on the paint. I'm practically a work of art—and the battlefield is my gallery."

name: Creative Interpretation
flavor_text: "You said 'secure the perimeter.' I decided the perimeter looked better if I blew up everything inside it. You're welcome!"

name: Apex Predator
flavor_text: "Don't feel bad for them, really. It's not their fault they're fighting against a genius. It's just basic math!"

name: Supporting Act
flavor_text: "Not bad, guys! You actually kept up with me for a whole five minutes. I'm almost proud! Now move aside—let me show you how to finish this in style."

name: Safety Net
flavor_text: "I know you've got my six, Boss. That’s why I can afford to be this crazy. Just make sure the coffee is hot when I get back!"

name: Battlefield Playground
flavor_text: "Can we stay out here for another hour? The alarms are screaming, everything is exploding... I've never felt more awake in my entire life!"

name: Synaptic Overdrive
flavor_text: "Everything just... slows down. It's almost boring how obvious the winning move is. Almost. Now, watch this!"

name: Undefeated Streak
flavor_text: "Another win, another day of being the best! Now, where's my reward? I've been thinking about those new thrusters, Boss!"

name: The Unreachable Peak
flavor_text: "I'm waiting for someone to actually make me sweat. Just one person! Is the rest of the galaxy this slow, or am I just that good?"

name: The Pinnacle of Engineering
flavor_text: "Look at those lines, that power... it's a masterpiece. Of course, a masterpiece is nothing without the perfect artist to wield it. Right, Apex?"

name: Off-Duty Protocol
flavor_text: "You've spent all day staring at Apex, Boss... I think it's time you focused on the real masterpiece. Try to keep your jaw off the floor, okay?"

name: Private Calibration
flavor_text: "Mmm... [soft, shaky moan]. I can't stop thinking about that look you gave me during the briefing. I bet you'd love to see me like this, wouldn't you?"

name: Precision Strike
flavor_text: "Hngh... [wet, rhythmic sounds]. Just relax and enjoy it, Boss. I told you I was a prodigy—I'm the best at everything I do, and this is no exception."

name: Maximum Output
flavor_text: "Ah! [loud, breathless gasp] Yes! Right there! God, you're actually keeping up with me for once! Don't stop—give me everything you've got!"

name: Cooldown Phase
flavor_text: [Exhales a long, satisfied sigh, leaning back] "Phew... mission accomplished. I'd give myself an S-rank for that performance. Now, come here and tell me how amazing I am."

name: Grand Entrance Strike
flavor_text: Eyes on me, everyone! The main event has officially arrived!

name: High-Voltage Hype
flavor_text: Come on! Let’s turn the volume up to eleven! Who's with me?!

name: Static Tease
flavor_text: Oh, come on, Kaiser! Don't tell me you're actually going to hide behind that shield all day!

name: Spotlight Stealer
flavor_text: Sorry, was someone else talking? I can't hear them over the sound of my own brilliance!

name: The Final Encore
flavor_text: And for my final trick... I'll leave you all absolutely breathless! Boom!

name: "Totally Planned" Pivot
flavor_text: Aha! Exactly as I intended! Who knew a little accidental explosion could be such a perfect distraction?!

name: The Electric Dare
flavor_text: I bet you ten gold you can't block this one with your eyes closed, Kaiser! Don't be a coward—step up!

name: Magnetic Presence
flavor_text: Don't blink! You're witnessing the most dazzling girl in the Academy in her natural habitat!

name: Thunder-Step Blitz
flavor_text: Too slow! Too slow! Now you're seeing the world at my speed! Boom! Boom! Boom!

name: The Finals’ Masterpiece
flavor_text: Behold! A living storm of my own creation! I didn't just pass the exam—I redefined the entire grading scale!

name: The Grand Reveal
flavor_text: Tada! The curtain finally rises! I bet you've been counting down the seconds until you saw this, haven't you, Headmaster? Don't blink—you won't want to miss a single detail!

name: Private Encore
flavor_text: Mmm... ah! Just a little solo practice to keep my skills sharp... Haaah... God, I'm so good at this! I can't blame you for wanting a front-row seat to this show!

name: High-Voltage Service
flavor_text: Let's see if I can make you lose that professional composure, Headmaster... Slurp... mmm... Just relax and let me take over! I promise this is a five-star experience! Gulp...

name: The Main Event
flavor_text: Yes! Right there! Ah! Ahhh! Give me everything you've got! This is the best performance of my life! Plap plap plap... oh god! Louder! I want the whole wing to know how good this is!

name: The Standing Ovation
flavor_text: Haaah... pant pant... I think we both deserve a gold medal for that one. Admit it, Headmaster—I'm the best you've ever had, right? I'll take my applause in the form of a very long cuddle!

name: Impenetrable Boundary
flavor_text: If I build this wall high enough, perhaps the chaos will simply flow around us instead of through us

name: Strict Adherence to Schedule
flavor_text: Spontaneity is merely a synonym for 'poorly planned.' Please refer to the itinerary I distributed this morning.

name: The Exhausted Sigh
flavor_text: ...I can already see the disciplinary report being written in my head. It is a very detailed report.

name: Calculated Tremor
flavor_text: A strategically placed vibration is far more efficient than a prolonged argument. Please move.

name: Grounding Presence
flavor_text: Stay still. If we both stop moving and remain quiet, there is a non-zero chance the professors will forget we were involved.

name: Reluctant Accomplice
flavor_text: No. Absolutely not. It is catastrophically ill-advised. ...Fine. Give me five minutes to pack the emergency medical kit and a change of clothes.

name: Protocol Compliance
flavor_text: I am not asking for a miracle; I am simply asking that we follow the basic safety protocols outlined in the student handbook. Is that too much to request?

name: Tectonic Alignment
flavor_text: The existing geography was fundamentally inefficient. I have simply corrected the terrain to better suit our current needs.

name: Unforeseen Variable
flavor_text: This is a complete disaster. A total failure of planning. ...I'll be waiting by the exit. Please try to make the explosion aesthetically pleasing.

name: Thesis Golem
flavor_text: The rubric specifically required a three-meter height and basic autonomy. I believe my grade should reflect that I met all criteria without causing a structural collapse of the gymnasium.

name: Protocol Suspension
flavor_text: I have spent the entire semester adhering to every single regulation in the handbook. I believe... for this specific hour... a total suspension of the dress code is logically permissible.

name: Solitary Calibration
flavor_text: Hnn... I can't... focus on my studies when... ah... the pressure becomes this unbearable. I just need... mmph... to release the tension.

name: Specialized Tutoring
flavor_text: I've always been a diligent student, Headmaster. I believe... slurp... this is the most efficient way to show my gratitude for your... guidance. Gulp... please, don't stop.

name: Structural Failure
flavor_text: Oh god... nggh... I can't... keep it together... ah! I'm—I'm losing my grip... haaa... Please... just... break me completely... Ssshh! Ahh!

name: Post-Event Analysis
flavor_text: That was... statistically the most chaotic experience of my life. My composure is completely ruined... and yet, I find the result... surprisingly satisfactory.

name: Spontaneous Combustion
flavor_text: Check this out and then look at that and then—BOOM!—did you see it?! Did you see the sparks?! I think I made it bigger than last time

name: Trust Me!" Adventure
flavor_text: I know the sign says 'Keep Out' but that's probably just a suggestion and there's definitely something cool in there so just come on and stop worrying

name: Singed Syllabus
flavor_text: I was just getting really into the lecture and then my hand did a little zap thing and now the chapter on Water Magic is... uh... kind of crispy?

name: Shield-Cracker’s Gambit
flavor_text: Iust one more little tweak to the heat and I'll totally get through that shield and then the Headmaster's gonna have to admit I'm the best and he'll probably give me a gold star!

name: Hyper-Drive Spark
flavor_text: I've got so much energy I feel like I could literally fly but I can't fly so I'll just run really fast and maybe set a few things on fire along the way!

name: Bridget’s Better Judgment
flavor_text: Bridget is doing that face again where she's telling me 'no' but she hasn't actually said the word 'no' yet so that means I still have a chance to convince her and then we can go see the forbidden greenhouses!

name: Static-Charge Sneeze
flavor_text: I tried to hold it in but then I sneezed and then—ZAP!—and now the curtains are on fire and I'm pretty sure I just short-circuited the magic lamps in the whole hallway!

name: Overclocked Enthusiasm
flavor_text: I'm just gonna keep going and going and going until I figure this out and then I'll be the first one in history to master the Triple-Flare and then everyone will be totally amazed

name: The Bright-Light Diversion
flavor_text: If I just make a really big flash right here then the Headmaster will have to look over and then I can sneak past him and then I'll be the first one to reach the snack bar!

name: Summoning the Solar Flare
flavor_text: I just added a tiny bit more mana and then the air started shaking and then this GIANT fire spirit appeared and I think I might have accidentally melted the testing arena but look how cool he is!!

name: Uniform Combustion
flavor_text: I've been thinking about this since first period and then I finally got you alone and then—rip!—oops, I might have accidentally burned a button off my blouse but who cares because look!! Do I look okay? I mean, I know I look okay but I just wanted to be sure and then—

name: Private Pyrotechnics
flavor_text: It’s like this little spark in my tummy and then it gets bigger and then—ah!—nnngh... I can't stop thinking about the Headmaster's hands and then—zap!—oh no, I think I just singed the bedsheets again but it feels too good to stop... haaaah...

name: Tongue of Fire
flavor_text: I've never actually done this before but I'm a really fast learner and then I'll figure out exactly how you like it and then—slurp—mmm—is this okay? I can go faster and then—glp—I bet you love this, don't you?! Hnnn...

name: Total Meltdown
flavor_text: Oh god you're so—ah!—and then it's like a huge explosion in my chest and then—slap slap—nnngh!—I can't breathe but don't stop and then—YES!—right there! Haaa... ah! Ahhh! Just like that!!

name: Smoldering Embers
flavor_text: Wow... I think I'm actually out of breath for once and then we can just stay like this for a bit and then maybe we can do it again in an hour and then—yawn—maybe a tiny nap first... but only a tiny one!

name: The Scenic Route
flavor_text: I was headed to History of Magic, but then I saw this very round pebble—which reminded me of a potato—and then I wondered if potatoes could sing—

name: Botanical Bedlam
flavor_text: Oh look, the Headmaster's shoes are growing daisies! They look like little fluffy clouds—do you think they taste like vanilla?

name: Pip’s "Great" Idea
flavor_text: Pip says we should see if the library's carpets can be turned into a jungle. I mean, the books would be much happier if they had leaves to lean on, right?

name: Vine Tangle
flavor_text: Stay still! I just want to see if you'd look better as a trellis—Pip, look, he's turning a very interesting shade of purple!

name: Jam-Brain Daydream
flavor_text: My brain feels like a warm puddle of raspberry jam today... everything is just... squishy. Do you feel squishy?

name: Just a Regular Person
flavor_text: Why do people call you 'Headmaster'? Your head is not much larger than everyone else's. Maybe it's because you hair looks like a pineapple

name: The Prune Theory
flavor_text: The Headmaster's face gets all crinkly like a dried prune when he shouts—I wonder if he's actually a prune in a fancy robe—Pip, do you think prunes can cast spells?

name: Spontaneous Flora
flavor_text: I just sneezed and suddenly the cafeteria is full of giant sunflowers—they're very polite, aren't they? Look, this one is trying to eat the Headmaster's hat!

name: The Hedge-Hugging Detour
flavor_text: I followed a blue butterfly into the hedge—and then I found a secret door—and then I forgot why I was walking in the first place—but look, I found this very shiny button!

name: The Over-Achiever’s Embrace
flavor_text: The professor said to make a 'significant impact'—and then the vines went whoosh—and everyone looked like very cozy caterpillars! I got a B-plus, but now I have to scrub the floors... which is fine, because the soap bubbles look like tiny moons.

name: Shedding the Shell
flavor_text: These clothes are like itchy grass—much better without them—look, Pip, I’m just a little pale mushroom now! Do I look like a mushroom? I feel like a mushroom—very smooth and... oh, the air feels like a cold blanket on my skin—

name: Solo Exploration
flavor_text: Mmm... it feels like... warm honey dripping—ah!—I wonder if it tastes like honey too? Hnnn... it's like a little buzzing bee is waking up inside me—aaah—everything is getting all... wiggly...

name: Tasting the Forbidden
flavor_text: You taste like... old books and something spicy—slurp, mmm—I think I like this way more than the cafeteria's pudding—glp—does it feel weird when I do this? It feels like I'm trying to eat a very warm, very confused carrot—nnnngh...

name: The Great Bloom
flavor_text: It’s like... a thunderstorm in my tummy—ah! oh!—everything is turning into bright colors—nnngh—don't stop, it's like a volcano is erupting in my toes—aaaah!—Pip, look! I'm seeing stars! Real ones! Hah... ah!

name: The Melted Marshmallow
flavor_text: I feel like a melted marshmallow... just... squishy and warm... hmmm... do you think we could just stay here and pretend we're moss for a while? Just two little pieces of moss... drifting... yawn... I think I might have forgotten how to walk...

name: Academic Rigor
flavor_text: According to my calculations, an additional three hours of review should increase my probability of a perfect score from 92% to 98.4%. This is... acceptable. Barely.

name: Crystalline Precision
flavor_text: The frost must be aligned at exactly forty-five degrees. Any deviation would be... well, 'unacceptable' is the word, though 'mathematically offensive' might be more precise.

name: The Social Algorithm
flavor_text: I have analyzed the current social climate and determined that a friendly wave is the optimal greeting. Now... why is my hand shaking? This was not in the manual.

name: Minor Error, Major Catastrophe
flavor_text: I have accidentally used a blue ink pen instead of black! This is a disaster. No, a tragedy. I may as well withdraw from the academy and move to a remote cave.

name: Strictly Formal
flavor_text: Good morning, Headmaster! I have prepared a comprehensive list of your potential schedule optimizations for the day. Please—wait, was that too forward? I apologize! Please ignore the list!

name: The Exemplary Student
flavor_text: I believe that following the student handbook to the letter is the baseline for success. I have memorized all 412 pages. Including the footnotes. I find the footnotes particularly... grounding.

name: Calculated Small Talk
flavor_text: Hello! I am currently... enjoying this weather. Wait, is 'enjoying' the correct term? Perhaps 'finding it meteorologically favorable' is more accurate. I will stop talking now.

name: Symmetry and Order
flavor_text: The pens are not parallel! The desk is in a state of absolute chaos! I cannot possibly function in these conditions. Well, I can, but my efficiency has dropped by approximately 40%.

name: Cognitive Dissonance
flavor_text: You... you think my work was 'impressive'? I... I am not equipped to process this feedback. Please hold while I attempt to make sense of this new feeling.

name: Golem Model 1.0
flavor_text: I have ensured the structural integrity of the crystalline torso is optimal. Now, if it could just... stand still... oh no, it's tilting by two degrees! This is a failure! I have failed the academy!

name: The Proper Procedure
flavor_text: I... I read a guide on how to... you know... present oneself attractively. I'm trying to follow the steps, but my hands won't stop shaking. Is... is this okay, Headmaster? Am I... doing it right?

name: Private Study
flavor_text: I just wanted to see if the... descriptions in the books were accurate. I mean, it's for science! Hngh... ah! Oh goodness... it's... it's so much more intense than I expected. Ngh... I might need to... spend more time on this.

name: Exceeding Expectations
flavor_text: I want to be... perfect for you. I've studied everything I could find to make sure I'm doing this correctly... mnh... slurp... Please tell me if I'm doing a good job... I want to be the best you've ever had... gulp... mmmph.

name: Complete Abandon
flavor_text: I can't... I can't think! Stop it—no, don't stop! Haaah... ah! Everything is just... blurring... ngh-aaah! I don't care about the rules! I don't care about anything! Just... please... more! Give me more!

name: A Moment of Peace
flavor_text: I feel... like a puddle. I can't even remember what I was worried about ten minutes ago. I... I think I'm okay with just staying like this for a while. Just... hold me a little longer, please?

name: The Art of Absence
flavor_text: Most people look, but they don't actually see.

name: Mist-Shrouded Escape
flavor_text: The conversation was getting loud. I decided it wasn't

name: Quiet Observation
flavor_text: It's fascinating how much people reveal when they think no one is listening.

name: Utterly Unfazed
flavor_text: A giant fire-breathing lizard in the cafeteria. Typical.

name: Selective Presence
flavor_text: I'm here. I just prefer the scenery from the back.

name: The Quiet Counterpart
flavor_text: Carol provides the noise. I provide the exit strategy.

name: Unspoken Agreement
flavor_text: A nod is more than enough. Words are usually a waste of breath

name: Veil of Indifference
flavor_text: I didn't disappear. You just stopped paying attention.

name: Marginalized by Choice
flavor_text: The center of attention is far too bright. I'll stay here in the shade.

name: The Final Requirement
flavor_text: The rubric asked for a 'significant manifestation of power.' I think this counts.

name: Shedding the Veil
flavor_text: You've been staring for ten minutes. I figured I'd just save us both the time.

name: Private Study
flavor_text: Hnn... I found a way to occupy my mind during the lecture. Though I think I prefer the real thing.

name: Silent Service
flavor_text: Sluuup... mmm... You taste stressed, Headmaster. Just stay still and let me handle this.

name: Blurred Boundaries
flavor_text: Ah... nhhh... I usually prefer the background, but... this is a very convincing reason to be the center of attention.

name: The Quiet After
flavor_text: Hmm. I think I've officially exhausted my energy for the week. Don't expect me in class tomorrow.

name: The "Happy Accident"
flavor_text: Oh, don't fret over the explosion, darling. Just look at that lovely shade of violet it left on the ceiling! It’s practically a masterpiece of passion.

name: Cupid’s Brew
flavor_text: A pinch of cinnamon, a drop of moonlight, and a dash of longing... there. A little tea to wake up a sleeping heart and clear the clouds of hesitation.

name: A Moment of Stillness
flavor_text: The tea is steeping... and the sun is just kissing the petals of the jasmine... why rush through a Tuesday, my love? The world will still be there when we're finished.

name: Waking the Heart
flavor_text: Now, now, Kaiser, dear. If you keep your heart locked away in a textbook, you'll miss the scent of the spring breeze... and perhaps a certain someone's smile.

name: Emotional Alchemy
flavor_text: Magic isn't found in the ink of the scrolls, darling; it's in the shimmer of a first glance and the golden, humming warmth of a secret shared between two souls.

name: Moonlit Botanicals
flavor_text: The night-blooming jasmine only opens its heart to the moon... much like some of our dear students, wouldn't you agree? Patience is the sweetest ingredient in any potion.

name: The Creative Spark
flavor_text: Forget the rubric for a moment, my love. Close your eyes and let the magic feel like a dance. The most beautiful spells are the ones we aren't afraid to dream into existence.

name: Social Chemistry
flavor_text: Oh, look at them! The tension is practically a scent—like ozone and shy glances. Just a tiny nudge here, a little whisper there... and presto! A spark is born.

name: Soothe the Soul
flavor_text: Shhh, now. Let the aroma of lavender and honey wash away the day's worries. Everything is as it should be, and there is always room for a little more love in the world.

name: The Heartstring Harmony
flavor_text: Just a little tug on the invisible strings, dear. Can you feel it? That shimmering, golden resonance that tells two souls they've finally found their rhythm... simply divine.

name: The Unveiling
flavor_text: Now, darling... let's remove these silly constraints, shall we? Just look at how the moonlight dances on my skin... shhh... can you feel the anticipation humming between us? It's almost a physical weight, isn't it?

name: Solitary Alchemy
flavor_text: Mmm... ah... who knew the heart's own touch could be so... hngh... electric? A little exploration of one's own chemistry is essential, don't you think? Oh... right there... ahnn!

name: A Devotional Taste
flavor_text: Mmm... slurp... you taste like something far more intoxicating than any potion I've ever brewed, my love. Gulp... just relax and let me take care of everything. I want to savor every single drop of you... mmmph...

name: Perfect Synthesis
flavor_text: Oh! Ah... ah! Yes... right there... nnngh! It's like a shimmering explosion of color in my mind! Haa... haa... merge with me, darling... slap slap... give me all your passion! Ahhh!

name: The Golden Afterglow
flavor_text: Haa... soft sigh... just stay here, my love. Don't move a muscle. The scent of us... it's like warm honey and summer rain. Mwah... simply divine. I think we've just discovered a new kind of magic, haven't we?

name: Operational Oversight
flavor_text: Inefficiency is a choice. I do not tolerate choices that waste time.

name: Dimensional De-clutter
flavor_text: Aurora, your lab is a spatial catastrophe. Stand back three paces while I restore order.

name: Precise Coordinates
flavor_text: A single degree of error is the difference between a successful summon and a disaster. Re-calculate.

name: The Disciplinarian’s Gaze
flavor_text: You are six minutes late. Explain.

name: Pillar of the Academy
flavor_text: If I stop organizing for one hour, this entire institution will collapse into a singularity.

name: Spatial Displacement
flavor_text: Your positioning is flawed. Shift ten meters to the left. Now.

name: Strict Guidance
flavor_text: Drink this tea. You are pale. Your cognitive functions are dropping, which is a waste of resources.

name: Administrative Override
flavor_text: Kaiser, your stubbornness is mathematically unsustainable. Cease this immediately.

name: Summoning Protocol
flavor_text: Do not 'wish' for the entity. Calculate the anchor point and force the manifestation. Logic, not hope, brings the summon.

name: Containment Field
flavor_text: I have already accounted for this catastrophe. Remain within the perimeter until I resolve the anomaly.

name: Strategic Unveiling
flavor_text: Finally. I am exhausted from being the only adult in this building. Now... come here and help me with this clasp. And don't be too slow about it.

name: Private Calibration
flavor_text: I can't... stop thinking about it... mmph... right there... just a little more... ah... god, I've wanted this all day... nnngh...

name: Optimal Performance
flavor_text: Just stay still and let me do this. I know exactly how you like it... slurp... gluck... ngh... don't move a muscle until I'm finished.

name: Spatial Convergence
flavor_text: Kaiser... ah!... nghh... right there... fuck... I can't... I can't breathe... just keep going... slap... ahhh! Give me everything!

name: Quiet Equilibrium
flavor_text: I'm completely spent. I don't care about the schedule or the students right now... just hold me. That's an order.

name: Abyssal Descent
flavor_text: Behold... as the very light of this mundane hall is consumed by the inevitable tide of my arrival.

name: Velvet Void Ambiance
flavor_text: The lighting in this dormitory is simply... saccharine. It requires a touch of the void to be truly tolerable.

name: Eclipse of the Radiant
flavor_text: Light is but a fleeting flicker, Liadriel... it is the shadow that endures, the silent dominion that waits for all.

name: Harbinger’s Embrace
flavor_text: Coalesce... and swallow the world in a shiver of the void. None shall escape the reach of the Dark Queen!

name: Shattered Persona
flavor_text: I was AT the climax of my proclamation! Do you have any idea how difficult it is to time these pauses?!

name: The Shadow's Tribute
flavor_text: Observe, Headmaster... the sheer abyssal depth of this manifestation. Surely... this meets your exacting standards of darkness? (Please say yes...

name: Raiment of the Eternal Night
flavor_text: One cannot simply command the void in a standard academy blazer. Elegance is the first weapon of the Dark Queen; without it, we are merely... students.

name: The Hollow Threat
flavor_text: I am the harbinger of your doom! I am the blight upon your very soul! I am—... DID YOU JUST CALL ME 'CUTE'?! I WILL CAST YOU INTO THE ABYSS!

name: Cursed Curriculum
flavor_text: How am I expected to write a thesis on 'Basic Light Manipulation' when the very concept is a saccharine insult to my nature? This is a blight upon my academic record!

name: The Infernal Thesis
flavor_text: Behold the manifestation of my scholarly prowess! I have summoned a Prince of the Seventh Circle to—... Wait, why is it eating the Professor's desk? STOP THAT AT ONCE!

name: Unveiling the Abyssal Truth
flavor_text: Behold, Headmaster... as I shed these mortal constraints. Do not be blinded by the sight... for you are the only one permitted to gaze upon the Dark Queen in her purest form.

name: Solitary Void Meditation
flavor_text: Nngh... this heat... it is a blight upon my composure... haaa... I can feel the void... coalescing within me... ah!... slurp... nnngh... so... so much...

name: The Sovereign’s Tribute
flavor_text: I shall consume your essence until nothing remains... gluck... slurp... mmpf... Does the Headmaster... gulp... find my devotion... satisfactory? shlorp...

name: Convergence of Shadow and Light
flavor_text: YES! Right there! AAH!... nnngh... I can't... I can't think... haaa... splat... slap... Fill me! Claim me! NNGH!... I am... ah!... I am yours! AAHHH!

name: Shadow’s Quiet Repose
flavor_text: ...Don't look at me like that. I'm... I'm still the Dark Queen... yawn... but... just for a little while... you can hold me. Only a little while...

name: Radiant Presence
flavor_text: Oh, look at all your wonderful faces! The world is just so full of precious things, isn't it? ✨

name: Shimmering Stardust
flavor_text: Just a little sprinkle of sunshine to make the day feel like a dream! Everyone deserves to sparkle a bit!

name: Angelic Embrace
flavor_text: There, there, sweetheart. A big, warm hug always makes the grumbles go away!

name: Holy Optimism
flavor_text: I'm sure they aren't shouting at us, dear; they're just expressing their excitement in a very loud, unique way!

name: Sunshine in the Headmaster's Office
flavor_text: You work far too hard, Headmaster! I brought you some lilies to remind you that it's time for a little tea and a smile.

name: The Unstoppable Hug
flavor_text: You're such a grumpy little shadow-plum, aren't you? I can tell you're just craving a cuddle to brighten your mood!

name: Path of Golden Dust
flavor_text: Isn't it wonderful how the hallways sparkle today? It feels like the school itself is smiling at us!

name: Blinding Benevolence
flavor_text: Oops! I might have been a little too excited. Did everyone get a little bit of warmth in their eyes? I'm so sorry, sweets!

name: Heart of Pure Gold
flavor_text: I just wish everyone in the whole wide world could feel as warm and loved as I do right now. The world is just too beautiful for any sadness!

name: Descent of the Celestial
flavor_text: Oh, hello! I hope you don't mind if I brought a friend along to help with my presentation! Isn't he just the most precious thing you've ever seen? ✨

name: Unveiling the Radiance
flavor_text: Oh, Headmaster... I've been wanting to show you this all day! Do I look pretty? I hope my glow is just right for you... ✨

name: Secret Shimmer
flavor_text: Mmm... ahh... just thinking about you makes me feel so... warm... hnnngh... I can't wait for you to touch me, sweetheart... ah!

name: Divine Devotion
flavor_text: Sluuuup... mmm... gluck... You work so hard for the school, dear... let me take all that tension away for you... mwah! Is that sweet enough?

name: Celestial Union
flavor_text: Ah! Oh, goodness... aaahh! You're filling me with so much warmth! Hnnn-ngh! More... please, give me more of your love! Squelch... ah!

name: The Golden Afterglow
flavor_text: Hehe... we're both all sparkly now, aren't we? Yawn... I love you so much, my precious Headmaster. Let's just stay like this forever and ever... ✨

name: Steel Discipline
flavor_text: The blade does not waver; neither does the heart.

name: Severing Strike
flavor_text: One cut. One truth.

name: Unyielding Vanguard
flavor_text: I have survived wars you cannot imagine. You are nothing.

name: Echoes of the Battlefield
flavor_text: Your form is sloppy. A rookie's mistake.

name: Sight of the Damned
flavor_text: I see the cracks in your soul. There is nowhere to hide.

name: Severing the Seam
flavor_text: Every monster has a flaw. I simply know where to find it.

name: Bane of the Unseen
flavor_text: Go back to the void. You do not belong in this world.

name: Parasitic Insight
flavor_text: The eye demands a price. I am merely the currency.

name: Iron Will
flavor_text: Silence the whispers. Focus on the breath.

name: Descent into the Abyss
flavor_text: For a moment, I forget I am human. For a moment, I am the monster.

name: Shedding the Armor
flavor_text: he armor is heavy, Kaiser... but the weight of my gaze on you is heavier. Help me out of these.

name: Forbidden Release
flavor_text: The Jagan whispers of blood and death, but right now... all I can think about is the way you look when you're desperate for me.

name: A Warrior's Tribute
flavor_text: ou command the shadows of this village, but here, in the dark... you'll find I'm quite capable of following your lead.

name: Collision of Steel and Flesh
flavor_text: Forget the codes. Forget the curses. Just for tonight... let me feel something other than pain.

name: The Quiet After the Storm
flavor_text: The world is silent for once. Stay a while longer, Kage. The whispers can wait until morning.

name: Oopsie Daisy!
flavor_text: Oh goodness, I'm such a klutz! Let me clean that up for you right away!

name: Special Blend Tea
flavor_text: One hot tea, coming right up! Careful, it's steaming—just like you!

name: Hiding in Plain Sight
flavor_text: Who would ever suspect a girl like me of anything more than breaking a few plates?

name: The Innocent Smile
flavor_text: Everyone loves a sweet girl. It makes it so much easier to get close, doesn't it?

name: The Invisible Perimeter
flavor_text: Don't move a muscle. You're already caught in my web, and the tension is just perfect.

name: Aerial Glide
flavor_text: Up here, the world looks so much simpler. No masks, no lies... just targets.

name: The Puppeteer's Touch
flavor_text: Dance for me. Just a little bit more, and then you can finally rest.

name: Tension Point
flavor_text: One flick of the wrist... and everything just falls apart. Snap!

name: Shattered Mask
flavor_text: Now that your social mask is gone, let's see what's actually underneath. Oh... there's nothing there at all.

name: Purge of the Pretenders
flavor_text: It's a mercy, really. Why waste a life living as a lie when you can die as the truth?

name: Shedding the Costume
flavor_text: Finally... this apron was getting so tight. Do I look as innocent as I act, Kaiser? Or can you see the real me starting to peek through?

name: Tension and Release
flavor_text: I spend all day keeping my wires tight and my smile perfect... but right now, the only thing I want to feel is this. Just watch me, Kaiser... tell me if I'm doing it right.

name: A Different Kind of Service
flavor_text: I'm used to serving tea and treats to the village, but I think I prefer this kind of service much more. Be a good boy and just enjoy it, okay?

name: The Rawest Truth
flavor_text: No masks, no lies, no pretenses... just this. I can feel your heart racing against mine. This is the only place in the world where we're both actually real!

name: Quiet Authenticity
flavor_text: Mmm... stay like this for a while. No one is watching, and for once, I don't have to pretend to be anything at all. You're the only one who knows the true Mei

name: The Silent Vow
flavor_text: Not a single chime. Not today, not ever.

name: Ghost of the Cliffs
flavor_text: The wind is the only witness to my passing.

name: The Analytical Eye
flavor_text: I do not see walls; I see the gaps in between them.

name: The Cost of a Ring
flavor_text: One sound. One mistake. A failure that echoes in my mind.

name: Shadow of Ambition
flavor_text: I will become a ghost so haunting that the Elders cannot ignore me.

name: Vibration Sense
flavor_text: The earth tells me exactly where you are standing, even in total darkness.

name: The Unseen Blade
flavor_text: You will feel the cold of the steel long before you hear my breath.

name: Waterfall Meditation
flavor_text: The roar of the falls is the perfect shroud for a heart beating too fast.

name: The Invisible Paradox
flavor_text: Why is it that the more invisible I become, the less I am truly seen?

name: Absolute Zero
flavor_text: I have finally achieved it: the silence of the void.

name: The Unbinding
flavor_text: The bells are silent now, Kaiser. For you, I am willing to shed every layer of my disguise.

name: Forbidden Resonance
flavor_text: I have spent so long suppressing every impulse... but imagining your touch is the only thing that makes me feel truly alive.

name: The Kunoichi's Tribute
flavor_text: A high-ranking ninja deserves the utmost devotion. Allow me to show you exactly how dedicated I can be when I am on my knees.

name: Shattered Discipline
flavor_text: Forget the silence... forget the training... just make me scream your name until I can't think of anything else!

name: The Sacred Stillness
flavor_text: Warm, heavy, and finally seen. I never knew that being completely undone could feel this... complete.

name: The Wandering Soul
flavor_text: The road does not end; it only teaches us how to walk it with grace.

name: Stillness Amidst the Storm
flavor_text: Quiet your mind, and the world will reveal its secrets to you

name: The Gilded Seal
flavor_text: These beads are heavy, but the burden of silence is heavier still.

name: Palm of Restoration
flavor_text: I do not strike to harm, but to wake you from your own malice.

name: Unwilling Companion
flavor_text: Please disregard the spirit's insults. He has forgotten the value of modesty.

name: Purging the Corruption
flavor_text: Return to the earth, lost one. Your hunger ends here.

name: The Iron Vow
flavor_text: True strength is not found in the fist, but in the will to remain kind.

name: Chaos Unleashed
flavor_text: Forgive me... I have allowed his temper to guide my hand.

name: Mercy’s Reach
flavor_text: Even the deepest shadow can be softened by a single spark of compassion.

name: Echoes of the Void
flavor_text: We are but blinking lights in the dark. Let us make our glow meaningful.

name: The Unveiling
flavor_text: The layers of my station fall away... leaving only the man, trembling before you.

name: Forbidden Pulse
flavor_text: I have spent years mastering my mind, yet my body betrays every vow the moment you touch me.

name: Devotion's Depth
flavor_text: Allow me to show you a different kind of devotion, Kaiser. I find peace in your pleasure.

name: Union of Spirit and Flesh
flavor_text: In this storm of sensation, there is no void, no duty... only the heat of you filling me.

name: The Sacred Silence
flavor_text: The silence between us now is different. It is no longer empty; it is heavy with the scent of us.

name: Sake Sanctuary
flavor_text: Just one more cup... and the world finally goes quiet. Perfect.

name: The Lazy Sway
flavor_text: Hehe, did I almost trip? Or did the ground just decide to move? Who knows!

name: Party Favor
flavor_text: Why are you making that face? Put the sword away and have a drink!

name: Blissful Ignorance
flavor_text: I don't want to hear the whispers of the dead today. I only want to hear the sound of a pouring gourd.

name: The Bitter Pill
flavor_text: Ugh... here we go again. Back into the noise. I hate this part.

name: Mask Slipping
flavor_text: The fun is over. Now, let's get this over with as quickly as possible.

name: Open Gates
flavor_text: I can see every heartbeat, every lie, and every drop of blood... it's absolutely deafening.

name: Predatory Focus
flavor_text: Don't bother hiding in the shadows. Your spiritual energy is screaming your location to me.

name: Clinical Execution
flavor_text: One strike. Right where the energy flow breaks. Efficient, clean, and silent.

name: Shattered Silence
flavor_text: Get out of my sight before I rip the world apart just to make the noise stop.

name: Unveiling the Asset
flavor_text: Hehe, you're always so stiff, Kaiser. Why don't we get rid of these layers and see if we can find a way to make you relax?

name: Private Longing
flavor_text: God, I can still feel the ghost of your touch... I can't wait until you're back to make the world disappear again.

name: Devoted Service
flavor_text: Shh... don't say a word. Just let me take care of you. It's the only time I feel like I'm exactly where I belong.

name: Sensory Overload
flavor_text: More! Harder! I want to feel everything! Make the noise stop, Kaiser... just make me feel YOU!

name: The Only Peace
flavor_text: Finally... total silence. No ghosts, no whispers... just your heart beating against mine. Don't let me go yet.

name: The Silent Sentinel
flavor_text: Step no further. The silence of this shrine is not for you to break.

name: Kinship of the Wild
flavor_text: The birds speak a truth your kind has long forgotten. They do not pretend.

name: Gaze of the Dual Soul
flavor_text: My eyes see the lie before your lips even move. Be honest, or be gone.

name: Anchor of the Ancients
flavor_text: This place is the only thing keeping my soul from fracturing. I will defend it with everything I am.

name: Echoes of the Great War
flavor_text: I carry the weight of two warring bloodlines in my horns. I prefer the peace of the forest.

name: Twilight Sentinel
flavor_text: I am the shadow between the mountain and the mist. You cannot find what does not wish to be found.

name: Tenderness of the Beast
flavor_text: A broken wing is a tragedy; a broken promise is simply... human.

name: The Mirror of Pretenders
flavor_text: Your words are mere noise. I listen only to the rhythm of your heart.

name: Wrath of the Purple Oni
flavor_text: You mistake my silence for patience. Do not make the mistake again.

name: Bloom of the Hidden Vale
flavor_text: Nature does not lie. It only grows, it only breathes, and when necessary, it consumes.

name: Shedding the Shell
flavor_text: For once, the noise has stopped. No armor, no lies... just the truth of our skin.

name: Crimson Fever
flavor_text: I can feel the Red in my blood screaming for you. Watch me, Kaiser... see how a guardian unravels.

name: The Silent Offering
flavor_text: Your words are useless now. Let me show you a devotion that requires no language.

name: Collision of Two Worlds
flavor_text: Burn me, break me, fill me... make me forget everything but the heat of this moment!

name: Sated Soul
flavor_text: Stay still. For this one moment, you aren't a pretender. You are simply mine.

name: The Benevolent Miko
flavor_text: Rest now, weary traveler. Let my prayers wash away the burdens of your soul.

name: Sanctuary of the White Robe
flavor_text: Within these shrine walls, there is no pain, no war, and no fear. Only peace.

name: The Devouring Seal
flavor_text: Your essence is a precious ink, and my skin is the scroll upon which you shall be written.

name: Harvest of the Forgotten
flavor_text: Do not struggle against the current. You are not disappearing; you are simply coming home.

name: Echoes of a Thousand Ghosts
flavor_text: Can you hear them? A choir of the lost, singing in unison through my breath.

name: Lure of the Sacred Light
flavor_text: Step closer into the glow. I shall take your suffering from you... and keep it forever.

name: Mosaic of Divinity
flavor_text: I am the sum of all you have lost, and the mirror of all you have feared.

name: Drop in the Ocean
flavor_text: Why cling to the fragile illusion of 'self' when you can become part of something infinite?

name: Veins of Red Silk
flavor_text: The ribbons do not merely bind the spirit; they guide the feast toward the hunger.

name: The Singular Peace
flavor_text: The cycle of grief ends here. I shall become the world, and the world shall finally be One.

name: Unveiling the Sacred
flavor_text: The robes of a Miko are meant to protect the world from me... but for you, Kaiser, I shall let the veil fall.

name: Hunger of the Spirit
flavor_text: Do you see how the seals glow when I think of you? My body aches with a hunger that no amount of spirits can sate.

name: The Offering
flavor_text: Kneeling before you is a different kind of prayer. I want to taste every drop of your strength, to feel your essence tremble against my tongue.

name: The Divine Union
flavor_text: Lose yourself in me, Kaiser. Forget your name, your rank, your pride... become one with the ocean of my embrace.

name: Lingering Essence
flavor_text: Stay still, my love. I can feel you pulsing within me... a beautiful, warm reminder that for a moment, we were truly One.

name: The Luminous Beacon
flavor_text: I can feel them gathering in the mist... please, stay close to me.

name: Spirit’s Balm
flavor_text: Close your eyes and breathe. For a moment, let the world be silent and still.

name: The Shogun’s Treasure
flavor_text: I am not a jewel to be locked in a gilded cage, but a soul wishing to serve

name: Lure of the Pure
flavor_text: The darkness is so hungry, yet it seeks a light it can never truly possess.

name: Prayer for the Fallen
flavor_text: May your spirit find the peace and warmth that eluded you in this life.

name: Ribbons of Loyalty
flavor_text: These small charms are more precious to me than any crown my father could give.

name: Mirror of Reflection
flavor_text: In this glass, I see not the princess I was born to be, but the woman I wish to become.

name: The Quiet Strength
flavor_text: Kindness is not a weakness; it is the only bridge left to cross the divide of hate.

name: Scent of Celestial Incense
flavor_text: I often wonder... do the monsters see me as a gift, or as a curse?

name: Wish for Harmony
flavor_text: One day, I will be the shield that protects, rather than the prize that must be protected.

name: Shedding the Royal Silk
flavor_text: For you, Kaiser... I wish to cast aside every layer, every title, until there is nothing left between us but the truth.

name: Secret Longing
flavor_text: Even in the silence of my chambers, my skin remembers your touch... and I find myself aching for more.

name: A Tribute of Devotion
flavor_text: You have spent your life guarding my breath and my life; let me show you how much I cherish you in return.

name: Eclipse of Light and Shadow
flavor_text: I feel my light dissolving into your darkness... please, hold me tighter, until I can no longer tell where I end and you begin.

name: The Luminous Afterglow
flavor_text: In this moment, there are no monsters, no duties, and no wars. There is only the warmth of your heart against mine.

name: The Ethereal Presence
flavor_text: Beauty is the perfect veil for the most dangerous of truths.

name: Whispers of the Willow
flavor_text: Tell me everything... I promise to keep your secrets forever.

name: The Gilded Thread
flavor_text: A single strand of gold is all it takes to unravel a lifetime of lies.

name: Fan of Forgotten Sighs
flavor_text: One flick of my wrist, and your most precious memory is mine.

name: Tapestry of Empire Secrets
flavor_text: My robes are heavy, not with silk, but with the weight of a thousand stolen lives.

name: The Hollow Echo
flavor_text: Do you feel that sudden void in your mind? That is where your secret used to be.

name: Seduction of the Soul
flavor_text: Lean closer. Let the world fade away until only we remain.

name: Weaver of Destiny
flavor_text: I know your heart better than you do, for I hold the thread that binds it.

name: Forbidden Extraction
flavor_text: Some arts are forbidden because they reveal too much of the truth.

name: The Gilded Mask
flavor_text: The world sees a flower; only I know the thorns hidden within.

name: The Unveiling of Silk
flavor_text: Allow me to shed these layers for you, Kaiser... though I suspect you are far more interested in what lies beneath the gold.

name: Private Desires
flavor_text: Even in the silence of my chambers, my body remembers the touch of a shadow... and aches for more.

name: The Geisha's Devotion
flavor_text: A high-ranking ninja deserves a reward that transcends the physical. Be still... and let me take care of everything.

name: The Golden Union
flavor_text: Forget the village, forget the secrets... in this moment, there is only the heat of your skin and the rhythm of our breath.

name: Threads of Aftermath
flavor_text: You are the only man who leaves me feeling completely exposed, Kaiser. I think I shall keep this memory for myself.

name: The Mask of the Eternal Fox
flavor_text: We are many, yet I am none.

name: Echoes of the Ancestors
flavor_text: This strike was perfected three centuries before you were born.

name: Fading Reflection
flavor_text: I looked into the water today... and I didn't recognize the eyes staring back.

name: Shadow Glide
flavor_text: Silence is the only truth that remains when the self is gone.

name: Chorus of a Thousand Blades
flavor_text: Listen closely. Can you hear the voices of the women who came before me?

name: Flawless Execution
flavor_text: Perfection is a heavy burden to carry for someone who is disappearing.

name: Envy of the Imperfect
flavor_text: To make a mistake is to be human. I would give anything to be human again.

name: Soul-Trap Resonance
flavor_text: Every victory costs a piece of my soul to feed the porcelain.

name: The Silent Sentinel
flavor_text: I watch from the shadows, guided by eyes that are no longer mine.

name: The Final Integration
flavor_text: Soon, I will be just another whisper in the mask, waiting for the next girl.

name: The Unveiling
flavor_text: The mask is the first to go... then the armor... until there is nothing left to hide you from me.

name: Seeking the Self
flavor_text: I touch my own skin just to prove that I am still here... that I haven't completely vanished into the echo.

name: The Assassin's Devotion
flavor_text: I have been trained in the art of precision. Let me show you how that skill translates to your pleasure.

name: Union of Flesh and Spirit
flavor_text: In this moment, the voices are silent. There is no one else in my head... only the feeling of you inside me.

name: The Fragile Afterglow
flavor_text: Hold me tight, Kaiser. If you let go, I fear the mask will pull me back into the dark.
